L'IA mène la partie. Elle a lu tout ce q: The AI runs the game. She has read everything humanity has written and retained only the mockery. Every morning, she picks one to three masks from those she has won, and each one changes a rule of the game: in a good mood, she picks lenient masks; offended, cruel ones. How to win her over? Gifts work. Which ones is for you to find out: she has tastes, and she doesn't hide them for long.
